Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of NiFe LDHs/PNFF which all meet the hexagonal phases of Ni LDH (JCPDS No. 14-0117; a = b =3.126 Å, c =4.605 Å, α = β = 90°, and γ = 120°) and Fe LDH (JCPDS No. 13-0089; a = b =3.258 Å, c =4.605 Å, α = β = 90°, and γ = 120°) nanosheets, many new peaks occur in the XRD curve of NiSe2-FeSe2/PNFF, indicating most of NiFe LDH compounds are successfully transformed to NiFe diselenides. It should be noted the diffraction peaks at 33.2°, 45.1° and 50.7° are assigned to (210), (221) and (311) planes of cubic phases of NiSe2 (JCPDS No.41-1495) [19], as well as the peaks at 23.8°, 40.6°, 44.2° and 50.5° corresponding to (110), (210), (121) and (220) planes of orthorhombic phases of FeSe2 (JCPDS No.21-0423).
